title: Cold Rooms and a Late Boost
story: The shared boiler ran until midnight because nobody wanted to be the person who cut it. After the quarterly bill, Denis proposed an earlier cutoff and a manual boost for late shifts. Two nurses objected until he showed the boost would cover their return. The timer changed, and the next bill fell. Their objection had been about coming home to cold rooms, not about defending waste.

vocabulary.definition: The heater that supplied the building with hot water or heat
The time when a system is switched off
An extra period of heat turned on by hand
Said they were against the plan
Using something carelessly when it is not needed

quiz.question: What extra heat did Denis offer to people on late shifts?
options: A manual boost to cover their return
A boiler that ran without any timer
A lower bill and no heat at all
Cold rooms as a lesson in saving
quiz.correctAnswer: A manual boost to cover their return
quiz.explanation: He proposed a manual boost for late shifts and showed it would cover their return.
quiz.supportingSentence: After the quarterly bill, Denis proposed an earlier cutoff and a manual boost for late shifts.

quiz.question: What happened to the bill after the timer changed?
options: The next bill fell
The next bill doubled
The bill was cancelled outright
The bill stayed high until midnight
quiz.explanation: Once the timer changed, the following bill fell.
quiz.supportingSentence: The timer changed, and the next bill fell.

quiz.question: What does the ending reveal about the nurses?
options: They wanted heat on return, not waste for its own sake
They hoped the quarterly bill would rise
They refused every kind of manual control
They preferred midnight cold to any boost
quiz.correctAnswer: They wanted heat on return, not waste for its own sake
quiz.explanation: Their objection was about coming home to cold rooms, so they were not trying to protect waste.
quiz.supportingSentence: Their objection had been about coming home to cold rooms, not about defending waste.

quiz.question: What is a boost in this passage?
options: Extra heat that can be turned on by hand
A cut that leaves the boiler off all night
A bill that arrives every three months
A complaint about a cold flat
quiz.correctAnswer: Extra heat that can be turned on by hand
quiz.explanation: The manual boost is the extra heat Denis offered for people finishing late.
quiz.supportingSentence: After the quarterly bill, Denis proposed an earlier cutoff and a manual boost for late shifts.

quiz.question: Why does the writer mention the quarterly bill?
options: To show what pushed Denis to change the timer
To prove the nurses owned the boiler
To suggest midnight was the cheapest hour
To argue that late shifts should be abolished
quiz.correctAnswer: To show what pushed Denis to change the timer
quiz.explanation: The proposal comes immediately after the quarterly bill, so the bill is the prompt.
quiz.supportingSentence: After the quarterly bill, Denis proposed an earlier cutoff and a manual boost for late shifts.
